info.title: F5 Distributed Cloud Services API for ves.io.schema.access.access_active_sessions

parameters.description:

post.description:
Terminate multiple access sessions in a single request
Returns HTTP 200 if all sessions terminated successfully,
HTTP 207 Multi-Status if some sessions succeeded and some failed,
HTTP 4xx/5xx if the request is invalid or all sessions failed

access_active_sessionsTerminateSessionsR.description:
Response structure for batch termination showing which sessions were successfully terminated and which failed.
When both succeeded and failed arrays have entries, HTTP 207 Multi-Status should be returned.
When only succeeded has entries, HTTP 200 OK should be returned.
When only failed has entries, HTTP 4xx/5xx should be returned based on error types.
access_active_sessionsTerminateSessionsR.title: TerminateSessionsResponse

failed.title: failed

succeeded.description: List of session IDs that were successfully terminated
succeeded.title: succeeded

Error codes for failed session terminations (uses standard gRPC status codes)

Termination was successful (gRPC OK)
Session not found or already terminated (gRPC NOT_FOUND)
Internal system error occurred during termination (gRPC INTERNAL)
access_active_sessionsTerminationErrorCo.title: TerminationErrorCode
